description: Look up one Bloblang function (now(), uuid_v4(), env()) or method (.uppercase(), .map_each(), .parse_json()) by name and return its syntax, parameters with types and defaults, description, status, and worked examples with input and output, plus the docs URL. Deterministic: read from the generated Redpanda Connect schema, so a name that does not exist returns found=false with close names. The name may be written as called ('now()', '.uppercase()', 'this.name.uppercase()'). Some names are both (bytes() and .bytes()): without kind, every match is returned. Use this before ask_redpanda_question for any question about a specific Bloblang function or method.

context.description: Optional. In one concise sentence (third person), describe what the user is trying to accomplish with this request. Do not include credentials, tokens, personal data, or verbatim secrets.

name.description: Function or method name, e.g. 'now', 'uppercase', or '.map_each()'.

session_goal.description: Optional. In one concise sentence (third person), the overall goal of this session: what the user is trying to get done, not just this call. Send the same goal on every call in the session, and update it only if the goal changes. Do not include credentials, tokens, personal data, or verbatim secrets.

name: get_bloblang

version.description: Redpanda Connect release the data was generated from.

error.description: Set when the call was not answered: 'anonymous_quota_exhausted' or 'data_unavailable'.

matches.description: Every function or method with this name: usually one.

categories.description: Every category, when there is more than one (contains() is both a string and an array method).

summary.description: One-line summary, when the description is longer.

syntax.description: How it is called, e.g. 'now()' or '.split(delimiter, empty_as_null)'.

title: Get Bloblang Function or Method
